newsitem.title: USA: CoreStates eliminates office of the chariman.
newsitem.headline: CoreStates eliminates office of the chariman.

text.p: CoreStates Financial Corp said Wednesday that it has eliminated its Office of the Chairman consisting of Terrence Larsen, Rosemarie Greco, Charles Coltman, Charles Connolly and Robert Gilmore and has moved decision-making functions into the company's individual business units.
CoreStates said that Gilmore has decided to leave the company at the end of 1996 to pursue other career interests.
The company said that Charles Connolly, chief risk policy officer, will move to a newly created position as a vice chairman of its CoreStates Bank NA unit.
He reports to Rosemarie Greco, president of the corporation and president and chief executive officer of the bank.

Gilmore's responsibility for the development of CoreState's Questpoint third party processing businesses is reassigned to Coltman, who is vice chairman of the corporation and the bank and manager ot its wholesale banking businesses, the company said.
Larsen remains chairman and chief executive officer.
